description: React component for user privacy settings, including toggles for profile visibility, name, location, about, points, heatmap, certificates, portfolio, experience, timeline, and donations, with options to save changes and download user data.

methods.name: toggleFlag
methods.description: Creates a function to toggle a specific privacy flag and mark that changes have been made.

methods.name: submitNewProfileSettings
methods.description: Handles form submission to save updated privacy settings if changes were made.
